title: Canonical valid RegisterSession
purpose: Provide a canonical RegisterSession request with a complete encapsulation header and the conservative 4-byte command-specific payload used by the previous strong seed.
expected_behavior: The target should accept the 24-byte encapsulation header and parse a valid RegisterSession request with a 4-byte command-specific body.
constraints_preserved: Length field is 0x0004 and matches the 4 bytes after the header.
Session handle is zero for initial registration.
Sender context is present as 8 bytes.
Total outer header size is 24 bytes.
issue_safety_notes: No issue enhancement is used; this is a conservative valid baseline request.
